premise: Bird sings and Squirrel chatters right under Owl's branch, until they learn why Owl sleeps in the sunshine.
inspiration: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse (Aesop), turned: two ways of living share one tree, and understanding replaces judging.
lesson: Friends can live by different clocks and still look after each other.
learning: Owls sleep in the day and wake up at night

en-US.title: Owl Sleeps All Day
en-US.text: {bird:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} {owl:face sleeping} It was a bright, sunny morning. {bird:enter} Bird {bird:face happy} {bird:hop} sang his loudest song. {sfx:tweet} Tweet-tweet-TWEET! {squirrel:enter} Squirrel {squirrel:shake} chattered and scampered up and down the tree. Chitter-chatter! High on his branch, {owl:enter} Owl {owl:live} blinked. He looked around. He fluffed his feathers, gave a big yawn, and went back to sleep. [curious] Why is Owl always asleep? asked Bird. [softly] The old tree rustled. Owl works at night, he said. When you go to bed, he wakes up and flies under the stars. Bird and Squirrel looked at each other. {bird:face surprised} {squirrel:face surprised} {bird:tint #FFB3C6} {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} Oh! So Bird sang his quietest song, tweet… and Squirrel tiptoed. {owl:face happy} {bird:face sleeping} {squirrel:face sleeping} [happily] And that night, when they were tucked up in bed, Owl hooted {sfx:hoo} {owl:hearts} a thank-you, hoo-hoo, just for them.

es-ES.title: Búho duerme todo el día
es-ES.text: {bird:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} {owl:face sleeping} Era una mañana de sol radiante. {bird:enter} Pájaro {bird:face happy} {bird:hop} cantaba su canción más fuerte. {sfx:tweet} ¡Pío-pío-PÍO! {squirrel:enter} Ardilla {squirrel:shake} parloteaba y correteaba arriba y abajo del árbol. ¡Chiqui-chiqui-chá! En lo alto de su rama, {owl:enter} Búho {owl:live} parpadeó. Miró a su alrededor. Se ahuecó las plumas, bostezó y siguió durmiendo. [curious] ¿Por qué Búho siempre está dormido?, preguntó Pájaro. [softly] El viejo árbol susurró con sus hojas. Búho trabaja de noche, dijo. Cuando vosotros os vais a la cama, él se despierta y vuela bajo las estrellas. Pájaro y Ardilla se miraron. {bird:face surprised} {squirrel:face surprised} {bird:tint #FFB3C6} {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} ¡Oh! Así que Pájaro cantó su canción más bajita, pío… y Ardilla anduvo de puntillas. {owl:face happy} {bird:face sleeping} {squirrel:face sleeping} [happily] Y esa noche, cuando ya estaban arropados en la cama, Búho ululó {sfx:hoo} {owl:hearts} un gracias, uh-uh, solo para ellos.

tweet.prompt: a small songbird singing a loud cheerful three-note chirp

hoo.prompt: a soft friendly owl hoot, two gentle notes, calm and warm
